Package neqsim.process.engineering.handover

Class Cfihos20HandoverExporter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.handover.Cfihos20HandoverExporter
public final class Cfihos20HandoverExporter extends Object
Exports a deterministic, auditable staging package for project-controlled CFIHOS 2.0 transformation.

The emitted CSVs are a NeqSim staging profile, not an official Principal bulk-loader template. Exact target-system transformation and CFIHOS acceptance remain outside the exporter.
